**Subject: IT Provisioning Request: New Sales Representatives (Start Date: Nov 9)**

**To:** IT Support Desk
**Cc:** Huda Al-Otaibi (HR Manager); Khalid Al-Shehri (Sales Manager)

Dear IT Support Team,

Please process the following IT access and software provisioning requests for three incoming Sales Representatives joining the B2B Packaging team on November 9. 

To ensure they are fully operational by their second week, please complete the following setup:

### 1. Account Creation
*   **Corporate Email:** Create three new Microsoft 365 Business Standard accounts.
*   **Active Directory:** Add users to the "Sales Department" security group to ensure access to shared network drives and internal sales documentation.

### 2. Software Licenses & Access
*   **CRM Access:** Provision three Salesforce (assumption) licenses with "Standard User" profiles.
*   **Sales Enablement Tools:** Provide access to the corporate product catalog database and the standard B2B quotation software.
*   **Communication:** Add users to the company-wide Microsoft Teams "Sales & Operations" channel.

### 3. Hardware Provisioning (Assumption)
*   Three standard-issue laptops configured with the corporate image.
*   Standard peripherals (headset, mouse, and docking station).

Please confirm once these accounts are provisioned and provide the temporary login credentials to me by November 7 so we can ensure a smooth onboarding process on their first day.

Best regards,

Nawaf Al-Dossary
IT Administrator

### Sales Buddy Assignment & Briefing Plan

**To:** Huda Al-Otaibi, Nawaf Al-Dossary
**From:** Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager
**Date:** October 26, 2023
**Subject:** Buddy Assignment and Onboarding Strategy for November 9 Cohort

#### 1. Buddy Assignments
The following senior sales representatives have been selected to mentor our three new hires for the period of November 9 – November 23:

*   **Buddy 1:** Sarah Mansour (Senior Account Executive) – Assigned to New Hire A
*   **Buddy 2:** Ahmed Fayed (Key Account Manager) – Assigned to New Hire B
*   **Buddy 3:** Layla Ibrahim (Senior Account Executive) – Assigned to New Hire C

#### 2. Buddy Briefing Notes
The following guidelines are to be shared with the assigned buddies to ensure a standardized onboarding experience:

**Role Expectations:**
*   **Shadowing:** Allow the new hire to sit in on all client calls and internal meetings for the first 5 days.
*   **System Navigation:** Ensure the new hire is comfortable navigating our CRM (Salesforce) (assumption).
*   **Product Knowledge:** Review the B2B packaging portfolio, focusing on technical specifications and current pricing structures.
*   **Culture & Policy:** Act as the first point of contact for questions regarding daily office operations and HR protocols (as outlined in the HR policy manual).

**Action Timeline:**
*   **Days 1–3:** Focus on system access, security protocols, and internal software orientation (Nawaf Al-Dossary to facilitate).
*   **Days 4–7:** Intensive product training and mock sales pitches.
*   **Days 8–10:** Supervised outbound prospecting and client interaction.
*   **Day 10 Goal:** The new hire must be capable of independently managing a basic client inquiry and drafting a formal proposal.

#### 3. Immediate Action Items
*   **Huda Al-Otaibi:** Please provide the new hires with the HR policy summary and finalize their induction schedules.
*   **Nawaf Al-Dossary:** Please ensure all three CRM accounts and hardware setups are ready by November 8.
*   **Khalid Al-Shehri:** I will conduct the kickoff meeting with the three buddies on November 2 to review these expectations and answer questions.

Khalid Al-Shehri
Sales Manager

# Sales Buddy Assignment & Briefing Plan

**From:** Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager  
**To:** Huda Al-Otaibi, HR Manager; Nawaf Al-Dossary, IT Administrator  
**Date:** October 27, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Buddy Assignments and Briefing Notes for November 9 New Hires

---

## 1. Sales Buddy Assignments

To ensure our three new sales representatives are fully operational and selling B2B packaging by the end of their second week, the following experienced sales team members are assigned as buddies for their first two weeks (November 9 – November 20, 2023):

| New Hire (Starting Nov 9) | Assigned Sales Buddy | Buddy's Experience Level | Buddy's Primary Focus Area |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| New Hire 1 | Faisal Al-Harbi | Senior Account Executive (4 Years) | CRM Navigation & Daily Sales Workflow |
| New Hire 2 | Reem Al-Mutairi | Senior Account Executive (3 Years) | B2B Packaging Product Portfolio & Catalogs |
| New Hire 3 | Ziyad Al-Ghamdi | Key Account Manager (5 Years) | Objection Handling & Live Client Shadowing |

---

## 2. Briefing Notes for Sales Buddies

### Objective
Guide your assigned new hire through their first two weeks (November 9 – November 20, 2023) to ensure they understand our B2B packaging products, master our CRM system, and execute their first independent sales outreach by the end of Week 2.

### Week 1 Focus: Setup, Systems, and Product Mastery (Nov 9 – Nov 13)
*   **Day 1 (Nov 9):** Welcome the new hire at reception at 8:30 AM. Introduce them to the team, tour the office, and ensure IT (Nawaf Al-Dossary) has provisioned their laptop, email, and CRM access.
*   **Day 2-3 (Nov 10-11):** Review the B2B packaging product catalog together. Explain core material grades, standard dimensions, custom printing options, and minimum order quantities (MOQs).
*   **Day 4-5 (Nov 12-13):** Sit side-by-side to demonstrate CRM data entry, lead tracking, and pipeline management. Have the new hire log practice accounts under your supervision.

### Week 2 Focus: Shadowing and Independent Execution (Nov 16 – Nov 20)
*   **Day 6-7 (Nov 16-17):** Conduct shadow sessions. Have the new hire listen in on at least five live outbound cold calls and client negotiation meetings per day. Debrief for 15 minutes after each call.
*   **Day 8-9 (Nov 18-19):** Supervise the new hire as they make their first independent outbound calls and draft client proposals using approved company templates.
*   **Day 10 (Nov 20):** Conduct a 30-minute end-of-two-weeks review. Identify strengths, address knowledge gaps, and confirm they are ready for independent pipeline management starting Week 3.

### Key Guidelines for Buddies
*   Be available for ad-hoc questions throughout the workday.
*   Maintain a supportive, constructive tone.
*   Coordinate with Huda Al-Otaibi (HR) if the new hire faces any administrative or policy-related hurdles.
*   Coordinate with Nawaf Al-Dossary (IT) immediately if any CRM or hardware access issues arise.

---
Khalid Al-Shehri

### Training Schedule: B2B Sales Onboarding
**To:** New Sales Representatives  
**From:** Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager  
**Date:** November 9 – November 20  

This schedule is designed to transition you from onboarding to active B2B packaging sales within two weeks.

| Day | Focus Area | Activity | Lead/Support |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | HR & Compliance | HR Policy review and documentation signing. | Huda Al-Otaibi |
| **2** | Systems Access | CRM account setup, email configuration, and security training. | Nawaf Al-Dossary |
| **3** | Product Knowledge | Technical specifications of packaging materials (corrugated/plastic). | Khalid Al-Shehri |
| **4** | Product Knowledge | Pricing structures, supply chain lead times, and inventory levels. | Khalid Al-Shehri |
| **5** | Sales Methodology | B2B consultative selling approach and lead qualification. | Khalid Al-Shehri |
| **6** | CRM Mastery | Managing the sales pipeline, logging calls, and task automation. | Nawaf Al-Dossary |

# Two-Week Sales Onboarding Schedule

**To:** {{first_name}}  
**From:** Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager  
**Date:** October 24, 2023 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Sales Representative Onboarding Schedule (November 9 – November 20)

---

### Week 1: Foundation, Products, and Systems

#### Day 1: Sunday, November 9 — Welcome & HR Orientation
*   **09:00 – 10:30:** Welcome session, office tour, and ID badge issuance (Led by Huda Al-Otaibi, HR Manager).
*   **10:30 – 12:00:** Overview of company HR policies, code of conduct, and benefits (Led by Huda Al-Otaibi, HR Manager).
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** IT Setup: Corporate email, network access, and hardware configuration (Facilitated by Nawaf Al-Dossary, IT Administrator).
*   **15:00 – 16:00:** Introduction to the Sales Team and assignment of buddy/mentor (Led by Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager).

#### Day 2: Monday, November 10 — CRM Navigation & Basic Usage
*   **09:00 – 11:30:** CRM Training Part 1: System navigation, dashboard overview, and viewing existing client accounts (Led by Nawaf Al-Dossary, IT Administrator). *(Note: User accounts and access permissions are pre-configured by IT).*
*   **11:30 – 13:00:** CRM Training Part 2: Managing leads, updating contact details, and logging daily activities (Led by Nawaf Al-Dossary, IT Administrator).
*   **13:00 – 14:00:** Lunch break.
*   **14:00 – 16:00:** Practical CRM Exercise: Entering practice leads and generating standard pipeline reports.

#### Day 3: Tuesday, November 11 — Core B2B Packaging Portfolio (Rigid & Corrugated)
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Deep Dive: Corrugated boxes, custom sizing, flute types, and grade specifications (Led by Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager).
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 16:00:** Deep Dive: Rigid boxes, luxury packaging solutions, and finishing options (foil stamping, lamination).
*   **16:00 – 16:30:** Q&A and daily wrap-up.

#### Day 4: Wednesday, November 12 — Specialized Packaging & Pricing Models
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Product Training: Flexible packaging, eco-friendly materials, and protective cushioning products.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** B2B Pricing Structure: Volume discounts, freight cost calculations, and quoting procedures (Led by Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager).
*   **15:00 – 16:00:** Mock Quoting Exercise using internal pricing sheets.

#### Day 5: Thursday, November 13 — Sales Methodology & Prospecting
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Sales Methodology: B2B consultative selling framework, identifying customer pain points in packaging supply chains.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** Cold Outreach Training: Crafting effective email templates and phone scripts for procurement managers.
*   **15:00 – 15:30:** Week 1 Review and feedback session with Khalid Al-Shehri.

---

### Week 2: Application, Shadowing, and Live Selling

#### Day 6: Sunday, November 16 — Shadowing Senior Sales Reps
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Live Call Shadowing: Listen in on outbound prospecting calls and client check-ins with assigned buddy.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 16:00:** CRM Practice: Logging call outcomes, scheduling follow-up tasks, and tracking pipeline stages based on morning observations.

#### Day 7: Monday, November 17 — Objection Handling & Negotiation Skills
*   **09:00 – 11:30:** Workshop: Handling common B2B packaging objections (price, minimum order quantities, lead times).
*   **11:30 – 13:00:** Role-playing negotiation scenarios in pairs.
*   **13:00 – 14:00:** Lunch break.
*   **14:00 – 16:00:** Shadowing client meetings (virtual or in-person) with Khalid Al-Shehri.

#### Day 8: Tuesday, November 18 — Proposal Generation & CRM Pipeline Management
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** End-to-end proposal creation: Combining product specifications, pricing, and terms into client-ready documents.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 16:00:** Advanced CRM usage: Managing deal stages from qualification to closing, ensuring accurate forecasting data.

#### Day 9: Wednesday, November 19 — Live Selling Practice (Simulated)
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Comprehensive sales pitch simulation evaluated by Khalid Al-Shehri and senior sales team members.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 16:00:** Refining pitches based on simulation feedback; drafting individual outreach lists for live execution.

#### Day 10: Thursday, November 20 — Live Outreach Launch & Graduation
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Live Outreach: New hires begin making independent outbound calls and sending proposals under buddy supervision.
*   **12:00 – 13:00:** Lunch break.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** Review of morning activity metrics in the CRM.
*   **15:00 – 16:00:** Onboarding completion review, goal-setting for Month 1, and sign-off with Huda Al-Otaibi (HR Manager) and Khalid Al-Shehri (Sales Manager).

03dde19c7f3707c022dd8d82801ecafe5586d3eb.text:
# Two-Week Sales Onboarding Schedule

**To:** {{first_name}}  
**From:** Khalid Al-Shehri, Sales Manager  
**Date:** November 9 (assumption)  
**Subject:** Sales Onboarding and Training Schedule (Weeks 1–2)

Welcome to the team. Below is your structured 10-working-day onboarding schedule designed to equip you with product knowledge, sales methodologies, and CRM proficiency so you are ready to sell by the end of your second week.

---

## Week 1: Foundations, Systems, and Core Products

### Day 1: Monday, November 9
*   **09:00 – 10:30:** Welcome and program overview with Sales Management.
*   **10:30 – 12:00:** Company policies overview and compliance orientation (assumption).
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** IT setup: CRM system access, email configuration, and communication tools (assumption).
*   **15:00 – 17:00:** Introduction to B2B packaging market segments and industry terminology.

### Day 2: Tuesday, November 10
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Core Product Line Training (Module 1): Corrugated boxes, shipping containers, and protective mailers.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** CRM Training: Navigating customer accounts, logging interactions, and managing pipelines.
*   **15:00 – 17:00:** Self-guided review of product catalogues and technical spec sheets.

### Day 3: Wednesday, November 11
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Core Product Line Training (Module 2): Custom-printed packaging, sustainable materials, and eco-friendly alternatives.
*   **13:00 – 15:00:** Sales Methodology Training: Introduction to consultative B2B sales frameworks and discovery questioning.
*   **15:00 – 17:00:** CRM Practice: Entering mock leads, opportunities, and tasks.

### Day 4: Thursday, November 12
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Sales Methodology Training: Qualifying prospects, identifying pain points, and value proposition mapping.
*   **13:00 – 17:00:** Shadowing Session (Part 1): Observe senior sales representatives during live outbound client discovery calls.

### Day 5: Friday, November 13
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Product Pricing and Margin Structure Training: Discount thresholds, volume pricing, and quoting procedures.
*   **13:00 – 16:00:** Weekly Review: Q&A session on Week 1 materials and CRM audit with Sales Management.
*   **16:00 – 17:00:** End-of-week reflection and goal setting for Week 2.

---

## Week 2: Advanced Application, Shadowing, and Live Selling Preparation

### Day 6: Monday, November 16
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Advanced Product Training: Industrial packaging solutions, heavy-duty crates, and custom dimensions.
*   **13:00 – 17:00:** Shadowing Session (Part 2): Observe client contract negotiations and renewal discussions.

### Day 7: Tuesday, November 17
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Objection Handling Workshop: Addressing common client pushbacks on price, lead times, and minimum order quantities.
*   **13:00 – 17:00:** CRM Advanced Usage: Generating sales reports, tracking conversion stages, and forecasting revenue.

### Day 8: Wednesday, November 18
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Proposal Writing and RFP (Request for Proposal) Response training.
*   **13:00 – 17:00:** Shadowing Session (Part 3): Listen-in on live customer onboarding and account management calls.

### Day 9: Thursday, November 19
*   **09:00 – 12:00:** Role-playing Exercise: Conduct simulated client pitch meetings covering discovery, product selection, and closing.
*   **13:00 – 17:00:** Refinement of personal pitch decks and CRM pipeline population with assigned target accounts (assumption).

### Day 10: Friday, November 20
*   **09:00 – 11:00:** Final Knowledge Assessment: Written review of product specifications and CRM proficiency.
*   **11:00 – 13:00:** Live Selling Readiness Review: Evaluation of mock sales pitch with Sales Management.
*   **14:00 – 17:00:** Official transition to active sales duties and assignment of active territory pipeline (assumption).

---

Khalid Al-Shehri  
Sales Manager
